How often should common areas be cleaned?

Common-area frequency follows traffic – foyers and lifts need daily attention, carparks and shared amenities a weekly cycle.

The common-area schedule matches resident load. High-traffic foyers and lift cars take daily attention through the working week; carparks, storage corridors and shared amenities hold a weekly cycle with monthly detail passes on top.

The strata cleaning checklist sets out the common-area items and their frequencies for committees auditing a scope. Quiet buildings stretch the roster; busy towers tighten it – the site audit sets the starting point and the visit log adjusts it. Short-stay towers and school-holiday buildings shift the load again, so the roster tightens around occupancy peaks instead of holding a flat weekly shape residents never see.
